data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and fund pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Elizabeth Park Capital Advisors' most recent 13F for June 30, 2026 shows positions in JMSB and PLBC.

On September 8, 2026, JMSB entered into a material definitive agreement (8-K Item 1.01) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1710482/000155278126000472/e26378_jmsb-8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
